steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation flow.
Enable eRFX functionality required for event creation.
Allow vendors to be added during event creation and keep Publish available.
Set the event type to RFQ and use whole-lot awarding.
Provide the mandatory event title.
Apply the first available RFQ template so the pricing sheet can be configured.
Add the specified product to the RFQ sheet.
Verify that the requested product was added.
Verify the product's automatically selected variant.
Enter the requested quantity.
Verify the quantity was retained.
Select the requested delivery location.
Verify the delivery location was selected.
Complete any remaining pricing-sheet fields required for publishing.
Add the vendor named in the test case.
Commit a schedule that starts now and lasts 15 minutes.
Verify the footer schedule chip starts at Now.
Verify the footer schedule chip shows the configured 15-minute duration.
Publish the configured RFQ and confirm the publish flow.
Verify that publishing reached a real project page.
Verify that Project Details displays the bidding end information after publication.
Confirm that no scheduling or publishing error is shown.
